name: guard-hpcc-homa-collectives-final
purpose: Candidate replacement for the initial All-to-All and ring-shaped panels; formal seeds are forbidden until both seed-1 cells pass.
selection_policy: Configurations advance through the committed ladder in order using only mechanism and safety gates. All-to-All selects 16 MiB because the 9 MiB diagnostic dropped Homa packets and the first predeclared larger buffer passed. Ring r0 and r1 failed at 16 MiB; r2 made GUARD and Homa safe at 32 MiB but HPCC still dropped packets, so this candidate advances to the final predeclared r3 level. Performance values are not selection criteria.

qualification.all_to_all: a0-buffer16 passed 240/240, zero switch drops and generic recovery, with all controller paths active
qualification.ring_open_loop: r0 and r1 failed the all-arm safety gate; r2 still recorded HPCC switch drops; testing final level r3-16mib-buffer32 next
